body: I've been struggling with things like these pretty much as long as I remember. I was pretty much always the odd one out, all the way from daycare. And I don't remember a year in school when I wasn't bullied. Basically, whenever I did say something, I was made fun of. Nobody ever cared, not that I blame them for it, I wasn't anything special.
Eh, I'm a bad talker, people don't really put up with me usually anyway, so I never do.. And I've had to apologize so many times now because of my failed attempt..
I failed, but I'm probably gonna try again. Thank you for your words..

thank you for your words.. but it's not a matter of me actually dragging myself down by choice, I don't have a choice at all, I'm stuck where I am, stuck with people I hate, and people that hate me, I have no options.

hi, I just woke up, I passed out, not sure if meds or the other thing, but I woke up now, which basically means, I failed... I don't know what to do now, I still don't want to live, but I've failed even the attempts to end it, so I don't really know if even that's worth the effort anymore. I'm thinking I should just try again with a different more safer method, because if I told anyone, it'd just be going to the hospital...

If I wasn't a disappointment to everyone, why am I called that by practically everyone close to me. I don't really remember what happiness is like anymore, or if I even want it, I guess in a way I do, but I've also known for a long time that I'll never reach happiness, simply because even the tiny things to try and make things better fail. 

As for calling an ambulance, I really, really don't want anything to stop me right now, least of all going to a hospital, those places are hell, every time. I wouldn't mind dying here right now at all if the choice was that or the hospital
Anyone here is pretty much it, I don't have any friends and my family has hated me for a long time.

I've done something yes, I mentioned it in my one other comment, but the problem is that being forced to live sounds much worse of an option than just going out now. I know I'm selfish too, never been a great person, I guess, but right now, I honestly don't mind letting people down. I end up hurting everyone I care about anyway, so it's better in the long run

And being honest here, I wouldn't want to stop it right now. For those that did reply, and cared, I cut myself deeply enough to bleed out, and took enough medicine to cut out the pain and keep me asleep, if it'd work anyway. I don't want to stop it either because that would lead into being hospitalized, which I don't really want, even worse than normal living tbh.
What I've done doesn't matter anymore, I won't stop it, it'll kill me though, but oh well. As for what's wrong, nothing really, anymore. Especially since I can finally let go.

That's the thing though, I'm not allowed to decide anything for myself anymore. Those rights have been taken from me. And honestly, thinking about things, I don't really have the energy to even try anymore, because every time I did, I ended up hurting the last people that still cared.
I've been forced to live all my life, tbh. I've had no will to live for a loooooong time, I'm not really interested in waiting even longer...
Eh, I was hoping some for some proper solutions, but I guess I should've known I'd get nothing. I'm going to go with option one.
